title: Si tuviera… haría
goal: a imaginar situaciones con if + pasado y would + verbo

ex.t: If I were rich, I'd have a house by the sea.
ex.es: Si fuera rica, tendría una casa junto al mar.

ex.t: If we had a boat, we'd sail to the islands.
ex.es: Si tuviéramos un barco, navegaríamos hasta las islas.

ex.t: Would you give up work if you won the lottery?
ex.es: ¿Dejarías de trabajar si te tocara la lotería?

vocab.es: donar a una ONG, a obras benéficas

ex.t: I'd give some money to charity.
ex.es: Donaría algo de dinero a obras benéficas.

ex.t: I'd share the money with my family.
ex.es: Repartiría el dinero con mi familia.

ex.t: If I were rich, I wouldn't change much.
ex.es: Si fuera rica, no cambiaría mucho.

ex.t: If I had more time, I'd learn to play the piano.
ex.es: Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería a tocar el piano.

vocab.es: en cualquier sitio, a cualquier sitio

ex.t: If you could live anywhere, where would you live?
ex.es: Si pudieras vivir en cualquier sitio, ¿dónde vivirías?

pron.title: La l muda de would
pron.tip: En would, could y should la l no suena: «wud», «kud», «shud». Y la o-u es una u corta, como en good.

exercises.q: If I ___ rich, I'd buy a house by the sea.
exercises.why: Con be, en la parte del if: were (también para I).

exercises.q: If we had a boat, we ___ sail to the islands.
If I ___ more time, I'd learn to play the piano.
exercises.why: En la parte del if, pasado simple. Nunca would have.

exercises.q: Would you give up work if you ___ the lottery?
exercises.why: La parte del if va en pasado, aunque esté al final: won.

exercises.q: If I won a lot of money, I'd ___ it with my family.
exercises.why: Después de I'd (I would), el verbo va en su forma base, sin to.

exercises.q: If my friend ___ nearer, we'd go for coffee every day.
exercises.why: No vive cerca: imaginamos, así que pasado (lived).

exercises.q: If I were rich, I ___ give a lot to charity.
If I had a big garden, I ___ some chickens.
exercises.why: Would + verbo base: would buy (I'd buy).

exercises.q: If you ___ how to drive, you'd be more independent.
If I have money, I'll buy a boat.
answer: If I had money, I'd buy a boat.
If I had money, I would buy a boat.

exercises.q: If I were rich, I'd give up work.
answer: If I were rich, I wouldn't give up work.
If I were rich, I would not give up work.

exercises.q: If I have a car, I'd drive to the coast every weekend.
exercises.why: Con I'd, la parte del if va en pasado: If I had a car. (Y nunca If I would have.)

exercises.q: If we had more money, we would travelled more.
exercises.why: Después de would, el verbo va en su forma base: we would travel.

exercises.es: Si fuera rica, viviría junto al mar
exercises.answer: If I were rich I would live by the sea
exercises.why: If I were…, I would live…

exercises.q: Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería a tocar el piano.
answer: If I had more time, I would learn to play the piano.
If I had more time, I'd learn to play the piano.
If I had more time, I would learn the piano.
If I had more time, I'd learn the piano.

pairs: I'd give a lot to charity.
I'd learn to play the piano.

dialog.title: ¿Qué harías tú?
dialog.setting: Yolanda y su hijo Hugo hablan por videollamada un domingo por la tarde

lines.t: Mum, what would you do if you were rich?
Hmm… I'd buy a house by the sea.
lines.es: Mmm… Me compraría una casa junto al mar.

lines.t: No, I wouldn't. I'd get bored!
Ha ha! And would you buy a boat?
Maybe a small one. And I'd learn to play the piano.
lines.es: Quizá uno pequeño. Y aprendería a tocar el piano.

lines.t: If you had a piano, I'd visit more often.
lines.es: Si tuvieras piano, te visitaría más a menudo.

questions.q: ¿Qué haría Hugo si su madre tuviera piano?
options: Se lo regalaría a un amigo

realLife.t: What would you do if you were me?
realLife.context: Para pedir consejo a una amiga o a tu hijo

summary: Segundo condicional: If + pasado, would + verbo (sin to)
If I had more time, I'd learn to play the piano
Con be: If I were rich… (were para todos)
Nunca would detrás de if: ❌ If I would have ✅ If I had
